suocera.aspetto: an uncanny tiny old woman in her late seventies who looks healthy but wrong, like a familiar face that is different from how you remember it: a small, stooped body; a smooth, pale, porcelain face with no wrinkles at all, like a doll's, far too young for her body; large eyes that are almost completely black, with almost no white; a small nose; a faint, fixed, closed-mouth smile that never changes; long, thin, smooth fingers; in widow's black from head to toe: black headscarf tied under the chin, black cardigan, black skirt and apron

parti.occhi: Large, almost completely black eyes, wet and shining, with almost no white; the lids a little reddened from crying; healthy: no fever, no sweat.

occhi_febbre.inquadratura: the eyes and the bridge of the nose, from the eyebrows to the cheekbones, the edge of the black headscarf
occhi_febbre.segni: Her almost-black eyes are glassy with fever, the lids red and swollen, beads of sweat on her smooth porcelain forehead under the edge of the black headscarf.

parti.bocca: Her lips, still in the same faint smile, part to show a full set of small, perfect, milk-white teeth, like a little girl's; healthy, nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the side of her neck under the jaw, the black headscarf pulled aside
collo.segni: Smooth, pale skin with no wrinkles, far too young for her age, a thin black ribbon around the neck; no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: the side of her neck under the jaw, the black headscarf pulled aside
collo_febbre.segni: Smooth, pale skin with no wrinkles and a thin black ribbon around the neck; under the jaw a hard swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning.

parti.mani: Long, thin, pale fingers, unnaturally smooth for her age, like a young woman's; dark earth under the fingernails, as if she had been kneeling at a grave; on the back of one finger a small, round, flat crust of dried red candle wax, dull and opaque like a crayon, dry and hard: no liquid, no shine, no wound, no blood.
